phaseName: Shell Interactions: Menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, Spaces
goal: Make the shell fully interactive: working global menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center (dark-mode toggle wired system-wide), Spaces, and complete window behaviors.
summary: Phase 2 complete: Shell fully interactive — menus, Spotlight, Launchpad, Control Center, Spaces, and complete window behaviors. Step 1: Data-driven menu system — appMenuRegistry + MenuBar with Apple/File/Edit/View/Window/Help menus, handler-map, Esc, shortcuts, aria-disabled. Step 2: Spotlight (Cmd+Space, app search, arrow navigation, Enter launches, document-level Esc) + Launchpad (app grid, click-to-launch, Esc) + Dock Launchpad icon. Step 3: Shared desktopStore (useSyncExternalStore, theme/wallpaper/brightness/wifi/bluetooth, localStorage persistence) + ControlCenter (Dark Mode wired, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/brightness/wallpaper) + Spaces (Mission Control overlay, add-space). Step 4: Window behaviors — resize handle, minimize-to-dock thumbnails, focus z-order, minimum size. Grader fixes: (1) Replaced all dangerouslySetInnerHTML with React JSX icon elements — AppManifest.icon changed from string to ReactNode, all consumers (Dock, Spotlight, Launchpad, WindowManager) render {app.icon} directly; grep confirms zero dangerouslySetInnerHTML hits in production code. (2) Spaces now actually filters windows by space — added spaceId field to WindowInstance, useWindows tracks activeSpaceId + assigns new windows to the active space, WindowManager filters visible+minimized windows by activeSpaceId, Spaces component calls onSelectSpace to switch; E2E test 'switching space hides windows from other spaces' verifies About window (Desktop 1) hides when switching to Desktop 2 and reappears when switching back. Full suite: `npx playwright test` → 35 passed; `npx vitest run` → 8 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (48 modules).
